OV E R V I E W
About Sudhanshu
Sudhanshu Kumar is a Bengaluru-based entrepreneur who builds companies at the intersection of
artificial intelligence and education. He is the Founder, Director and CEO of two companies —
Engagesphere Technology Private Limited and Euron Systems Private Limited — and leads Euron
Consulting, the group's technology services division. Across these ventures his focus is consistent:
make practical, production-grade AI skills accessible, and build the software infrastructure that lets
other institutions deliver learning at scale.
Before  Euron,  Sudhanshu  co-founded  iNeuron,  an  EdTech  company  that  was  acquired  by
PhysicsWallah. That experience — building a large learner community and seeing what actually
moves people from curiosity to employability — shapes how he designs programmes today: depth
over surface, projects over passive viewing, and a direct line between what is taught and what the
job market asks for.
He  works  as  a  hands-on  founder.  Alongside  running  the  businesses,  he  personally  authors
curriculum, teaches cohorts, writes product requirement documents for enterprise clients, and
shapes the cloud architecture his products run on. He builds in public, sharing his work and thinking
with a wide audience across LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram and X.

E U R O N  ·  B 2 C
Teaching AI that gets people hired
Euron is where Sudhanshu's teaching shows most directly. The platform focuses on taking learners
from fundamentals to job-ready AI engineering, and much of its core material is written by him
personally — from a full neural-networks masterclass with complete backpropagation derivations to
teaching manuals on retrieval-augmented generation, LLM evaluation and AI system architecture.
The  flagship  Super  30  Work  &  Learn  programme  now  runs  a  24-week  AI  Engineering  track
structured in seven phases. Its design reflects a clear belief: learners should ship real work every
week.  Students  build  projects,  publish  to  GitHub,  explain  their  work  on  video,  and  develop
communication skills alongside technical ones.
Design principle: depth over surface, projects over passive viewing — and a direct
line from what is taught to what the job market asks for.

E U R O N  S Y S T E M S  ·  B 2 B  &  K- 1 2
Infrastructure for learning at scale
Euron Systems turns what Sudhanshu learned running learner-facing platforms into a product other
organisations can use. Its multi-tenant, white-label LMS lets colleges, training companies and
creators launch their own branded academies — on the web and as mobile apps — without building
the technology themselves.
The platform is engineered for real-world operation: tenant-level custom domains, server-driven UI
for per-tenant customisation, live-class integration, WhatsApp-based engagement, and app-store
distribution  with  dynamic  course  pricing.  It  runs  on  AWS,  provisioned  with  Terraform  across
development, test and production environments.

Alpha Euron — AI-first learning for Grades 4–12
Alpha Euron is the group's K-12 brand. Rather than exam coaching, it is positioned around future-
readiness: helping children understand and build with AI and science from an early age. Its IQ1000
layer delivers virtual labs — space, physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics — as click-and-
build simulations on mobile and desktop, with each lab broken into atomic, step-by-step topics that
explain the underlying science. Courses are planned as recorded, mentor-led content pitched
specifically for children.
Sudhanshu Kumar — Founder Profile

E U R O N  C O N S U LT I N G
Enterprise AI, built end to end
Through Euron Consulting, Sudhanshu takes the same engineering depth to enterprise clients.
Engagements typically run from problem framing and PRDs through high- and low-level design,
capacity and cost planning, and delivery on a React, Python and AWS stack — with self-hosted or
on-premise LLM options where data security demands it.
A representative engagement is an agentic AI customer-support platform for a large private bank,
designed to scale query handling tenfold without adding headcount, while keeping the language
model on the bank's own GPU infrastructure. Other work spans supplier-risk intelligence, fleet
diagnostics, on-premise analytics assistants, biometric authentication and AI operating systems for
schools.

J O U R N E Y
Milestones
Figure 3 — Key milestones in Sudhanshu's entrepreneurial journey.
Sudhanshu's path runs in a straight line from education to infrastructure. iNeuron proved that a
large community of learners would invest in practical technology skills. Euron refined that into a
sharper, AI-engineering-first offering. Euron Systems packaged the underlying platform so other
institutions could benefit, and Alpha Euron extends the mission to the next generation of learners
while they are still in school.

Looking ahead
The next chapter is about compounding the ecosystem: growing Euron's AI engineering cohorts,
scaling  Euron  Systems  as  the  white-label  platform  of  choice  for  institutions,  launching  Alpha
Euron's IQ1000 labs for school learners, and bringing production-grade agentic AI to enterprises
through  Euron  Consulting.  The  aim  throughout  stays  the  same  —  make  serious  AI  capability
accessible, and build the systems that let learning happen at scale.
